import os
from datetime import datetime, timedelta, timezone
from datadog_api_client import ApiClient, Configuration
from datadog_api_client.v2.api.logs_api import LogsApi
from datadog_api_client.v2.model.logs_list_request import LogsListRequest
from datadog_api_client.v2.model.logs_query_filter import LogsQueryFilter
from datadog_api_client.v2.model.logs_sort import LogsSort

def query_error_logs(payload, config=None):
    config = config or {}
    dd_config = Configuration()
    dd_config.api_key["apiKeyAuth"] = config.get("api_key") or os.environ["DATADOG_API_KEY"]
    app_key = config.get("app_key") or os.environ.get("DATADOG_APP_KEY")
    if app_key:
        dd_config.api_key["appKeyAuth"] = app_key
    dd_config.server_variables["site"] = config.get("site") or os.environ.get("DATADOG_SITE", "datadoghq.com")

    severity = payload.get("severity", "error")
    minutes = int(payload.get("minutes", 15))
    start = payload.get("start")
    end = payload.get("end")
    now = datetime.now(timezone.utc)
    from_time = start or (now - timedelta(minutes=minutes)).isoformat()
    to_time = end or now.isoformat()
    limit = int(payload.get("limit", 100))

    query_parts = []
    if severity:
        query_parts.append(f"status:{severity}")
    if payload.get("query"):
        query_parts.append(str(payload["query"]))
    query = " ".join(query_parts) if query_parts else "*"

    with ApiClient(dd_config) as api_client:
        api = LogsApi(api_client)
        response = api.list_logs(
            body=LogsListRequest(
                filter=LogsQueryFilter(
                    _from=from_time,
                    to=to_time,
                    query=query,
                ),
                sort=LogsSort.TIMESTAMP_DESCENDING,
                page={"limit": limit},
            )
        )
    result = [
        {
            "id": item.id,
            "timestamp": getattr(item.attributes, "timestamp", None),
            "message": getattr(item.attributes, "message", None),
            "status": getattr(item.attributes, "status", None),
            "service": getattr(item.attributes, "service", None),
            "host": getattr(item.attributes, "host", None),
            "tags": getattr(item.attributes, "tags", None),
        }
        for item in getattr(response, "data", []) or []
    ]
    return result
